meta.title: 5 Stoic lessons for dealing with difficult people

beats.text: Five Stoic lessons for dealing with difficult people.
One. Marcus began each day expecting to meet the rude and ungrateful. Forewarned, he wasn't thrown.
Two. They act from their own ignorance, not against you. It's rarely as personal as it feels.
Three. You can't control their behaviour — only your response. That's the only battle worth fighting.
Four. The best revenge is not to become like them. Don't let their chaos rewrite your character.
Five. We're all teeth and claws of the same body, Marcus said. To work against each other is unnatural.
You'll never run out of difficult people. So make your calm the thing that doesn't depend on them.
